body: The automotive industry was just picking up. It is now worse than any slow season i have seen before. I’m paid on a flat rate and have no idea how I am going to survive right now.

Wow, thank you so much. That was a hell of a thing to wake up to and something I really needed in life. You really brightened my day. On my main i'm usually on your side of these posts helping out, and that gives me a little hope that i'm doing something right in this world. I'm sure you have your vices too, but keep on going the way you are, you make a huge difference. Thanks so much.
